# The Bloodline Watchers Series

> Official authority file and lore manifest for The Bloodline Watchers supernatural thriller and mythic fiction series by award-winning author Orion R. Veil, published by Cosmic Quill LLC.

## Core Series Information
- **Title**: The Bloodline Watchers
- **Author**: Orion R. Veil
- **Publisher**: Cosmic Quill LLC
- **Genres**: Supernatural Thriller, Cosmic Horror, Dark Fantasy, Mythic Fiction
- **Official Hub**: https://www.thebloodlinewatchers.com/
- **Key Themes**: Ancient bloodlines, ancestral memory, inherited suffering, hidden covenants, esoteric New Orleans history.

## Novels in Chronological Order
- [Book One: The Awakening](https://books2read.com/thebloodlinewatchers/): Winner of Most Immersive Setting (Booky Awards), Literary Titan Silver Book Award, Second Place in Fantasy (The BookFest Fall 2026), and 5-Star Editorial Review from Reader Views. Forgotten bloodlines begin awakening and cosmic forces unravel ordinary reality.
- [Book Two: The Covenant](https://books2read.com/TheBloodlineWatchers-TheCovenant): Winner of Boldest Concept (Booky Awards). Ancient covenants re-emerge, old alliances fracture, and the occult war beneath history escalates.
- Book Three: The Convergence: Scheduled release 2027. The collision of bloodlines and the crossing of the threshold.

## Character Archives & Lore (28 Dossiers)

### Family
- **Sam Howardson (BW-01 — The Unexpected Center)**: Ordinary man who inherits hidden ancestral truth; forces beyond human understanding force him to reclaim his family's buried past.
- **Krishtan Dauvee (BW-02 — The Keeper of Old Ways)**: Rooted in the spiritual traditions of New Orleans, carrying generational occult knowledge beneath sharp wit and commanding presence. (Also listed under Guardians and Allies.)
- **Celine Grimhold (BW-03 — The Questioning Spirit)**: Intelligent, independent investigator confronting supernatural mysteries that challenge conventional reality.
- **Luke Grimhold (BW-04 — The Steadfast Protector)**: Practical, observant, and loyal defender navigating impossible circumstances to protect those close to him.
- **Audrey Thorne (BW-05 — The Guardian of Faith)**: Grounded in faith, family, and conviction, reconciling traditional religious devotion with events that challenge her understanding of the divine.
- **Harold “Hal” Thorne (BW-06 — The Grounded Observer)**: Audrey’s husband; values reason, family, and everyday rhythms until extraordinary circumstances unfold close to home.
- **Marisol Dauvee (BW-07 — The Dauvee Seeker)**: Traveled from England to New Orleans seeking answers regarding her mother’s disappearance, entering a family history shaping the city.
- **Kay Grimhold (BW-08 — The Quiet Witness)**: Oklahoma matriarch who raised her children with both feet on the ground while keeping parts of her own past close, noticing what others miss.
- **Charles Howardson (BW-09 — The Builder)**: Gifted craftsman and plumber who built a family cabin over decades with foundations that waited for another generation.
- **Pauline Howardson (BW-10 — The Keeper of Pages)**: Filled ordinary pages with names and coded details no one else knew how to read, leaving behind records for the right hands.
- **Loyd Howardson (BW-15 — Kay’s Brother)**: Kin at Tenkiller before anyone’s clue, carrying a presence and family history known deeply to Kay and Sam.
- **Stellan Grimhold (BW-16 — The Carpenter)**: Father of Audrey, Luke, and Celine, who once put his hands to work for a cause he believed in.
- **Ivory Dauvee (BW-17 — The Family on the Wall)**: Pictured on Kay’s wall, joining the Dauvee and Howardson histories across generations.
- **Leontine Dauvee (BW-18 — Marisol’s Mother)**: Named in an old New Orleans family photograph, connecting Marisol to the Dauvee line.

### Guardians and Allies
- **Jake (BW-19 — The Quiet Watchman)**: Former Saints practice squad player whose quiet presence and single nod bring reassurance to the people Krishtan trusts.
- **Dominic “Dom” (BW-20 — The Familiar Face)**: Taken under Krishtan’s wing after Katrina, bringing steadiness and humor in tense rooms.
- **Brother James (BW-21 — The Cathedral Watchman)**: Bears rope scars on his palm from years of work at the cathedral, watching, listening, and weighing what needs saying.
- **Leonard “Leo” Macgwyre (BW-22 — The Keeper of the Watch)**: Keeps watch from Atlanta with knowledge of the Howardsons reaching back to Charles.
- **Sister Marie du Chêne (BW-23 — The Woman in Lyon)**: Studied extraordinary phenomena in Lyon for years, recording journals that guided Griffin Black to her door.
- **Griffin Black (BW-24 — The Soulmancer)**: Texan healer guided by Sister Marie’s journals whose work demands a personal price each time he puts his hands on another person.
- **Warren Clay (BW-25 — The Trueward)**: From West Virginia, discerning who a person truly is when others have already judged them dangerous.
- **Emily Brosse (BW-28 — The Church Kitchen)**: Moves through the familiar work of a church community, bringing meals and care to neighbors in need.
- **Margaret Hollins (BW-29 — The Woman Who Kept a Copy)**: Grounded member of her church community who puts troubling matters in writing and stands behind her own name.

### Sovereign Hope and Paladin
- **James Brownlow (BW-11 — The Voice of Sovereign Hope)**: Speaks from Tulsa to sanctuaries far beyond the city, offering a timely invitation to a family seeking answers.
- **Gayland Hyland (BW-12 — The Man Behind the Glass)**: Works away from the pulpit behind the glass, studying the human body with the patience of a craftsman and the conviction of a believer.
- **Ezekiel Smith (BW-13 — The Covenant Steward)**: Courteous, steady-handed steward from Tulsa who understands every word inside a ministry document.
- **Dr. Niles Cavendish (BW-26 — The Field Harmonics Lead)**: Tracks elusive signals at Paladin Trust, investigating what vanished a moment before.
- **Chris Brosse (BW-30 — The Man from Stone & Sheaf)**: Moves easily between the church and the jobsite, offering steady work under the mark of Stone & Sheaf.

## Verified Honors, Awards & Critical Praise
- Distinguished Author Seal — International Impact Book Awards
- Second Place (Fantasy) — The BookFest Awards Fall 2026 (Book I: The Awakening)
- Winner: Most Immersive Setting — Booky Awards (Book I: The Awakening)
- Winner: Boldest Concept — Booky Awards (Book II: The Covenant) — Judged by Dr. Aiyana Reyes: *"The Covenant does something rare in urban fantasy: it builds its supernatural system out of how a family actually lives... A mythology that carries a rule that costly is a world earning belief one detail at a time."*
- Silver Book Award Winner — Literary Titan (Book I: The Awakening)
- 5-Star Editorial Review & Official Entry — Reader Views (Book I: The Awakening) — Reviewed by Paul Knobloch: *"Memory becomes a form of knowledge, family becomes a source of power, and inherited suffering becomes something that can be confronted rather than merely repeated..."*
